# Text.PadStart

```m
Text.PadStart(text as nullable text, count as number, optional character as nullable text) as nullable text
```

Returns text of a specified length by padding the start of the given text.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/text-padstart)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `nullable text` | no |
| `count` | `number` | no |
| `character` | `nullable text` | yes |
